createInvoice.question: How do I create my first invoice?
createInvoice.answer: To create an invoice, go to the 'Invoices' section in the sidebar and click the 'New Invoice' button. Fill in the client details, add products or services, and save. The system will automatically calculate totals and Sales Tax.

addClient.question: How do I add a new client?
addClient.answer: Go to the 'Clients' section and click 'New Client'. Enter the tax ID or national ID, name or business name, address and contact details. Clients will be saved for future use.

convertProforma.question: Can I convert a proposal to an invoice?
convertProforma.answer: Yes, from any proposal detail page, you'll find the 'Convert to Invoice' button. This will automatically create a new invoice with all the proposal data.

generateReports.question: How do I generate reports?
generateReports.answer: In the 'Reports' section you can select the date range and the type of report you want (sales, clients, products). The charts will update automatically and you can export the data to PDF or Excel.

companySettings.question: How do I change my company settings?
companySettings.answer: Go to 'Settings' where you can update your company data, receipt series, logo, currency and other system preferences.

vatCalculation.question: Does the system automatically calculate Sales Tax?
vatCalculation.answer: Yes, the system automatically calculates Sales Tax (18%) on all products and services, unless you configure a product as tax exempt.

introduction.content: InvoiceApp ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our Service.

1.question: Is InvoiceApp really free to start?
1.answer: Yes! Our Free plan lets you create up to 5 invoices per month with 3 clients at no cost. No credit card required to sign up. You can upgrade anytime as your business grows.

2.question: Can I customize my invoices with my branding?
2.answer: Absolutely. You can add your company logo, choose colors, and customize templates to match your brand. Professional plans offer even more customization options.

3.question: How do digital signatures work?
3.answer: Send invoices or proposals with a signature request. Your clients receive an email link to sign digitally. All signatures are timestamped and legally binding.

4.question: Can I track payments and send reminders?
4.answer: Yes. Track which invoices are paid, pending, or overdue. Set up automatic payment reminders to ensure you get paid on time.

5.question: Is my data secure?
5.answer: Security is our top priority. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We use industry-standard security practices and regular backups.

6.question: Can I use InvoiceApp on mobile?
6.answer: Yes! InvoiceApp is fully responsive and works great on phones and tablets. Create, send, and manage invoices from anywhere.

7.question: What payment methods do you accept?
7.answer: We accept all major credit cards through Stripe. You can pay monthly or yearly, with a 17% discount on annual plans.

8.question: Can I export my data?
8.answer: Yes. Export your invoices, client data, and reports to PDF, CSV, or Excel at any time. Your data is always yours.
